mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals robust labor market conditions, which historically precedes corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which historically precedes stronger economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% indicates broad-based economic expansion, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST rise by at least 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a sustained year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as policy tightening risks accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential investment (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals strong housing market activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects broader economic confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic weakness pressures corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by at least 0.2 percentage points signals central bank response to inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as accommodative policy supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS decline by ≥0.2pp
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market recovery, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0% and then falls below 4.5%.
